g.text: Title: ESP32 Racing Dash Wind Sim - Fan Controller

g.desc: Title: ESP32 Racing Dash Wind Sim - Fan Controller

g.text: Through-hole only. ESP32 DevKit V1 30-pin socket, mini 5V buck, ILI9488 SPI display

g.desc: Through-hole only. ESP32 DevKit V1 30-pin socket, mini 5V buck, ILI9488 SPI display

g.text: Display: Hosyond 3.5in ILI9488 SPI + XPT2046 touch, 1x14 header.

g.desc: Display: Hosyond 3.5in ILI9488 SPI + XPT2046 touch, 1x14 header.

g.text: VSPI: SCK=18 MOSI=23 MISO=19, TFT CS=15 DC=2 RST=4, T_CS=21 T_IRQ=22.

g.desc: VSPI: SCK=18 MOSI=23 MISO=19, TFT CS=15 DC=2 RST=4, T_CS=21 T_IRQ=22.

g.text: Fan channels (Arctic P12 PWM PST CO, 4-pin): fans powered from switched 12V.

g.desc: Fan channels (Arctic P12 PWM PST CO, 4-pin): fans powered from switched 12V.

g.text: 2N7000 = open-collector PWM driver into fan pin 4 (fan pulls up internally, up to 5V - do NOT drive from GPIO directly).

g.desc: 2N7000 = open-collector PWM driver into fan pin 4 (fan pulls up internally, up to 5V - do NOT drive from GPIO directly).

g.text: Signal is INVERTED: GPIO high = 0% fan duty. Use LEDC invert or duty = max-x. FETs off at boot = fans full speed.

g.desc: Signal is INVERTED: GPIO high = 0% fan duty. Use LEDC invert or duty = max-x. FETs off at boot = fans full speed.

g.text: 10k gate pull-downs; 10k tach pull-ups to 3V3 (GPIO34/35 have no internal pull-ups). Fan tach = open collector.

g.desc: 10k gate pull-downs; 10k tach pull-ups to 3V3 (GPIO34/35 have no internal pull-ups). Fan tach = open collector.

g.text: D2/D3: 12V rail clamps at each fan connector - protection margin for fans with weak internal transient clamping.

g.desc: D2/D3: 12V rail clamps at each fan connector - protection margin for fans with weak internal transient clamping.

g.text: 12V input & power: PSU -> J1. J2 = panel switch (fans only).

g.desc: 12V input & power: PSU -> J1. J2 = panel switch (fans only).

g.text: Buck module (mini 5V, 17.5x12mm, 1mm corner wire holes) wires to J6; D1 blocks USB back-feed into buck.

g.desc: Buck module (mini 5V, 17.5x12mm, 1mm corner wire holes) wires to J6; D1 blocks USB back-feed into buck.
